text:
Anna (AE): FYI Bridgehill POC is greenlit but procurement emailed a bunch of blockers around PO, KMS, and signature routing. Need quick alignment.
Liza (Finance): They want NET30 and a PO before we spin up dedicated capacity. Is billing contact on the order form confirmed?
Anna (AE): Billing contact is billing@bridgehill.com per SOW. They also asked for a credit line: 2 weeks free pro rata for the POC (up to $5k). Can we do that?
Mike (Legal): Quick read: customer redlined section 5 (liability cap) and added mandatory KMS proof in DPA. We can accept limited KMS language but not indemnities. Share redline snippet.
Sara (Security): Bridgehill requires keys in their KMS (customer-managed) or HSM proof. We need to validate network egress for private deployment. Also asked for SOC2 + penetration test report.
Josh (SRE): For private deployment we need the PO and a signed addendum with seat counts. If they insist on customer KMS, we'll need onboarding window for key exchange and IAM mapping (estimate 5 business days).
Liza (Finance): How does the PO map to order form fields? They sometimes put billing address + remit to which delays vendor setup.
Anna (AE): I pasted the minimal PO template they asked to fill:```po_number: <customer_po>\namount: 4500\ncurrency: USD\ndescription: Bridgehill POC - dedicated 2 GPUs for 14 days\nbill_to: Bridgehill Inc, 123 Market St\nbilling_contact: billing@bridgehill.com\nship_to: N/A\nterm: NET30```\nMike (Legal): Regarding signature flow, customer wants to countersign our MSA and DPA. Proposed flow by Bridgehill: customer sign -> their legal countersign -> our AE finalizes -> exec sign. We prefer: AE sign (acceptance) -> customer sign -> Redwood legal countersign. Counterparty first signing can complicate countersign tracking.
Anna (AE): They specifically requested that the MSA be countersigned by their VP Legal before we provision. Can we ask for a scanned signature or e-sign enveloped to their legal contact?
Mike (Legal): E-sign is fine. Request: route DocuSign envelope with signing order: 1) Bridgehill AE (accept PO) 2) Bridgehill Legal (countersign) 3) Redwood Legal (final). We need an audit trail and final signed PDF.
ops-bot: New artifact created: <link to draft order form> (auto)
Sara (Security): Also they added clause requiring key custody proof. We can accept a limited attestation: customer provides KMS ARN + IAM policy snippet and we validate via a test object. We cannot ship keys to a 3rd party HSM on their behalf.
Josh (SRE): Implementation note: if customer-managed KMS, include an onboarding step in the ticket with these items: 1) KMS ARN 2) test-crypto-object 3) IAM role/email for rotation. I'll add template commands.
Josh (SRE): Template snippet to validate KMS (to send to customer):```aws kms encrypt --key-id <KMS_ARN> --plaintext \"redwood-test\" --output text```\nLiza (Finance): If they send a PO with different billing name, vendor setup will take extra time. Ask them to put "Bridgehill Inc" exactly as in tax W-9.
Anna (AE): Bridgehill legal also redlined SLA to 99.99% uptime for the POC evidence period. Can we push back?
Mike (Legal): 99.99% is a high bar. For POC we should offer a trial SLA of 99.9% with credits capped at monthly fee pro rata. I'll propose language: 'POC period: SLA target 99.9%; credits limited to usage fees during POC.'
Sara (Security): Also request from them: export control clause for models and data residency. They want EU data to stay in eu-west-1 for any production follow-up. For POC that's fine if we limit dataset location.
Anna (AE): Summary / ask: 1) @Mike can you draft reply accepting limited KMS attestation + propose 99.9% POC SLA? 2) @Liza confirm the PO template and credit (2 weeks up to $5k) OK to finance. 3) @Josh confirm onboarding checklist and estimated provisioning lead time. 4) I'll route DocuSign with requested signing order once legal ok.
Mike (Legal): On it. I'll produce a short reply with tracked changes and the suggested SLA language by EOD.
Liza (Finance): Finance OK on the credit, need an approval ticket: I'll create PO hold and send vendor setup link to Bridgehill billing. Net30 accepted.
Josh (SRE): I can do onboarding checklist and timeline: 3 business days after PO + signed MSA/DPA + KMS attestation. Will add runbook steps.
Anna (AE): Great — I'll hold off provisioning until docuSign envelope is routed. I'll ping Bridgehill procurement for PO formatting and send the KMS validation snippet.
Bridgehill (external): thanks team — we'll fill PO and confirm KMS details by tomorrow.
Anna (AE): Perfect. I'll follow up with a single email thread consolidating action items and include the draft order form link. :thumbsup:
